# Paths whose change requires a green Integration test run at the PR head.
# One pattern per line. A pattern ending in `/` or `*` matches every path
# starting with it (the `*` is dropped); any other pattern is an exact path.
# `unless-version-only` exempts a change whose only edited lines are the
# `"version"` field.
# Read by .github/workflows/integ-gate.yml.

# The published construct the demo stacks deploy.
packages/cdk-glue-iceberg-table/lib/iceberg/
packages/cdk-glue-iceberg-table/package.json unless-version-only
# Demo stacks.
lib/
# The `app:` entry of cdk.json, parsed by every `cdk` invocation.
bin/arceus.ts
# Feature flags and the `app:` declaration.
cdk.json
# What `npm ci` installs: the lockfile fixes the `aws-cdk-lib` and `aws-cdk` versions.
package.json
package-lock.json unless-version-only
# The Node version the job installs.
.nvmrc
# Compiler options ts-node applies to the `app:` entry.
tsconfig.json
# Every file under scripts/ is run or sourced by the integration job.
scripts/
# The gate's own rules and code.
.github/integ-trigger-set.txt
.github/scripts/
.github/workflows/integ-gate.yml
